sn12.27:2.10: Normally the path leads to the cessation of “suffering”. This shows another way of integrating dependent origination with the path.
sn12.27:3.1: The remaining items are presumably to be expanded per [sn12.2]().
sn12.27:5.1: One who knows the path and dependent origination is a stream-enterer, for which the next phrase supplies a series of synonyms.
sn12.27:5.2: The idiom _āhacca tiṭṭhati_ is used for the river “pressing into” the ocean ([mn73:14.1]()), or the tongue “pressed against” the roof of the mouth ([mn100:17.2]()).
